title_block.title: MIRA Control functional overview
MCU - Host processor, memory and supervision
STM32 supply, clocks, reset and debug
STM32 FMC and 64 MiB SDRAM
MCU nonvolatile storage and board control
FPGA - FPGA platform, configuration and communications
FPGA supply domains and local bypass
FPGA configuration, recovery and XADC supply
USB Type-C and 32-bit FPGA FIFO
FPGA DDR3L memory and 200 MHz reference
Ethernet physical interface and MCU buffers
DAC - Programmable analog sources
Thirty-two programmable bit-line voltages
Service voltages, current limits and forming source
FPGA control of the DAC bank
MATRIX - Crossbar control and analog routing
Matrix commands and hardware interlocks
Eighty-bit switch-control image
Bit-line DAC connections, clamps and service selection
Service source, bit-line bank and polarity routing
Word-line drive and neuron-line selection
Crossbar socket and bias
ADC - Current conversion and measurement
Matrix current conversion and monitor selection
Precision references, monitor scaling and matrix ADC
PROTECTION - Write-current control and fault response
Write-current setpoint, selectable shunt and gate clamp
Write overcurrent trip, fault memory and power inhibit
